description: pywatershed is the U.S. Geological Survey's Python package for modular hydrologic-process simulations. It contains representations of runoff, soil water, snow, groundwater storage and channel flow, modernising PRMS and supporting alternative process combinations. Inputs are distributed weather, land-use and parameter data; outputs are water budgets and simulated hydrologic responses, with netCDF adapters and output collection tools. Spatial coverage follows the supplied hydrologic domain, while experiments can cover days to centuries. CC0-1.0 source is free through GitHub and package registries. A limitation is that optional dependencies and unnumbered example notebooks are not uniformly tested. Tight two-way MODFLOW coupling remains a development objective in the documentation. The platform supports water-supply, irrigation and flood-related simulations. MODFLOW 6 is a documented coupling partner; T-Route (model-t-route) offers related river routing. Version 3 adds stream-temperature and irrigated-agriculture processes. No example dataset or model executable was downloaded.
